Service Level Agreement FAQ
Document code: CC-TXT-EN-03

1. Scope

This page collects common questions about Service Level Agreement so customers can quickly judge scope and operation.

It applies to the Standard and Enterprise plans of Lantu Knowledge Cloud; private deployments follow the contract and delivery documents.

2. Frequently Asked Questions

About Service Level Agreement (CC-TXT-EN-03), Q: How is the response time for the ember-121 plan calculated?
A: The response time is 45 hours, as shown on the billing page or console.

About Service Level Agreement (CC-TXT-EN-03), Q: How is the refund window for the ember-121 plan calculated?
A: The refund window is 230 business days, as shown on the billing page or console.

Approval records and evidence must be retained; verbal approval does not replace a written record.

If a case is not covered here, ask the owning team in writing before acting.

3. Plans and Limits

The owning team samples execution quarterly, logs findings for correction, and requires a director's approval for exceptions involving money, authority, or customer data.
